rules.statement: The Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance does not provide for the appointment of a person to act as Diyawadana Nilame during the temporary absence from the Island of the holder of the office.
rules.supporting_quote: "The Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance contains no provision for the appointment of a person to act as Diyawadana Nilame, during, the temporary absence from the Island of the holder of the office."
